products.title: JOBY HandyPod™ Clip Extend Tripod
products.body_html: HandyPod™ Clip Extend is a 106g multi-mode tripod for compact cameras with an extendable pole, 360° ball head, cold shoe accessory slot, and even a hook for hanging on ledges or railings. Then use the built-in carabiner to clip it to your bag or belt, so it's always on hand.

variants.title: Default Title

products.title: JOBY GripTight® Cold Shoe Mount
products.body_html: GripTight® Cold Shoe Mount is the one mount built to do it all. Attach to any cold shoe rig, screw onto any 1/4" tripod, snap on magnetic accessories, and unlock unique phone-and-camera workflows. Tilt to any angle and it holds, no locks, no fumbling. All in a pocket-sized package.

variants.title: Default Title

products.title: JOBY TelePod® Mini Tripod
products.body_html: TelePod® Mini packs a 6-section telescoping pole, dual cold shoe mounts, a 5600K fill light, and a wireless remote into a palm-sized package. Just stash it in your pocket or clip it to your bag and go. Now, your complete kit is always within reach.

variants.title: Default Title

products.title: JOBY NanoPod Magnetic Tripod
products.body_html: NanoPod is light enough to forget it's in your pocket, yet durable and versatile enough to replace a whole bag of gear. It switches between tripod, selfie stick, desktop stand, and magnetic mount mode in seconds. However you need it, NanoPod folds to fit the task.

variants.title: Default Title

products.title: JOBY PodZilla® Octo Suction Tripod
products.body_html: PodZilla® Octo has flexible, bendable legs with suction cup tips that'll stand, wrap, and stick on any surface. At 146g, it's the compact creative companion that goes wherever you go. Shoot from any angle, anywhere the adventure takes you!
